scope: Bounded ordinary-call discriminator, isolated smaller initial candidate, accepted encoder ABI baseline freshly built on Zen. Same-wire resident controls are included; this is not the strongest prior spectrum and contains no Calico timings. Compiler profile full x86 AVX512/VBMI/VBMI2/GFNI for both labelled families.
